button.name: Text label
button.description: Button text must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with the button background in every state. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final background after the overlay is applied.

button.name: Essential icon or spinner arc
button.description: An icon used instead of text must have at least 3:1 contrast with the button background. The moving spinner arc must also meet 3:1. An icon beside a visible label does not need its own check.

button.name: Badge text
button.description: Badge text inside a button must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with the Badge background. Check all 14 built-in Badge colors in Rest, Hover, and Pointer down on page and surface backgrounds. This covers 336 pairs per mode. Check custom end content separately.

button.name: Visible control boundary
button.description: The button edge needs 3:1 contrast only when users need it to see the control. A text-only button can rely on its label.

button.name: Keyboard focus indicator
button.description: The focus outline needs at least 3:1 contrast with the area around the button. Check every style. Destructive buttons use a red outline.

button.name: Disabled appearance
button.description: Disabled controls do not need to meet these contrast ratios.

button-group.name: Text label
button-group.description: Text in each button must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with its background in every state. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final background after the overlay is applied.

button-group.name: Essential icon or spinner arc
button-group.description: An icon used instead of text must have at least 3:1 contrast with the button background. The moving spinner arc must also meet 3:1. An icon beside a visible label does not need its own check.

button-group.name: Visible control boundary
button-group.description: Some groups need a divider or edge to show each button. That divider or edge must have at least 3:1 contrast.

button-group.name: Keyboard focus indicator
button-group.description: The focus outline must have at least 3:1 contrast with the area around it.

button-group.name: Disabled appearance
button-group.description: Disabled controls do not need to meet these contrast ratios.

checkbox-input.name: Checkbox box
checkbox-input.description: The box edge (unchecked) and fill (checked) must have at least 3:1 contrast with the surface behind them. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final colors after the tint and the pressed overlay are applied.

collapsible.name: Trigger label
collapsible.description: The trigger text must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with the surface behind it. For Pointer down, measure against the pressed overlay the trigger row paints while it is pressed.

icon-button.name: Essential icon or spinner arc
icon-button.description: IconButton has no visible label. Its icon must have at least 3:1 contrast with the button background in Rest, Hover, and Pointer down. The moving spinner arc must also meet 3:1 while loading.

icon-button.name: Visible control boundary
icon-button.description: The button edge needs 3:1 contrast only when users need it to see the control.

icon-button.name: Keyboard focus indicator
icon-button.description: The focus outline must have at least 3:1 contrast with the area around the button. Check the red outline on destructive buttons too.

icon-button.name: Disabled appearance
icon-button.description: Disabled controls do not need to meet these contrast ratios.

link.name: Link text
link.description: Link text must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with the background behind it. For Pointer down, measure against the pressed overlay the link paints behind its text.

radio-list.name: Radio circle
radio-list.description: The circle edge (unselected) and fill (selected) must have at least 3:1 contrast with the surface behind them. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final colors after the tint and the pressed overlay are applied.

segmented-control.name: Text label
segmented-control.description: Each label must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with its segment background. Check unselected, Hover, Pointer down, and selected colors as they appear on screen. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final background after the overlay is applied.

segmented-control.name: Essential icon
segmented-control.description: When a segment has no visible label, its icon must have at least 3:1 contrast with the segment background. An icon beside a visible label does not need its own check.

segmented-control.name: Selected state indicator
segmented-control.description: The selected background must reach 3:1 only when users need it to tell selected from unselected. Label color and weight also show selection.

segmented-control.name: Visible control boundary
segmented-control.description: The control edge or segment borders need at least 3:1 contrast when users need them to see the choices.

segmented-control.name: Keyboard focus indicator
segmented-control.description: The focus outline must have at least 3:1 contrast with the area around the segment. Check it on the track and selected background.

segmented-control.name: Disabled appearance
segmented-control.description: Disabled controls do not need to meet these contrast ratios.

slider.name: Thumb
slider.description: The thumb must have at least 3:1 contrast with the track and the surface behind it. Pointer down is the whole drag: measure the thumb with the pressed overlay applied.

switch.name: Track and thumb
switch.description: The on and off tracks must each have at least 3:1 contrast with the surface behind them, and the thumb with its track. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final colors after the tint and the pressed overlay are applied.

tab-list.name: Tab label
tab-list.description: Each label must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with the tab surface behind it. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final background after the overlay layer is applied.

toggle-button.name: Text label
toggle-button.description: The label must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with the button background when selected and unselected. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final background after the overlay is applied.

toggle-button.name: Essential icon or spinner arc
toggle-button.description: An icon-only ToggleButton must have at least 3:1 contrast between its icon and button background. The moving spinner arc must also meet 3:1. An icon beside a visible label does not need its own check.

toggle-button.name: Selected state indicator
toggle-button.description: The selected background must reach 3:1 only when users need it to tell selected from unselected. Label weight or a changed icon can also show selection.

toggle-button.name: Visible control boundary
toggle-button.description: The button edge needs 3:1 contrast only when users need it to see the control. A visible label or icon can show the control instead.

toggle-button.name: Keyboard focus indicator
toggle-button.description: The focus outline must have at least 3:1 contrast with the area around the button. Check both selected and unselected states.

toggle-button.name: Disabled appearance
toggle-button.description: Disabled controls do not need to meet these contrast ratios.
